projection.scope: complete retained XML byte envelope and every parsed document node
projection.document_envelope: XML declaration, public doctype, interstitial padding, three pre-root comments, root byte region, and terminal padding are independently inventoried
projection.source_head: all ThML.head metadata, editorial history, rights, source attribution, contact details, and both style representations are readable in the TEI front transcription; principal metadata is also projected semantically into teiHeader
projection.source_body: every ThML.body descendant is projected in document order as readable TEI with stable source-to-target accounting
projection.source_text: visible direct text and child tails are preserved exactly; structural whitespace remains bound in the complete node crosswalk and raw byte regions
projection.source_attributes: meaningful body attributes are projected to TEI linking, reference, numbering, type, subtype, rendition, or milestone attributes; every attribute remains exact in the crosswalk
projection.document_containers: ThML is represented by the TEI document; ThML.head by teiHeader plus front transcription; ThML.body by TEI text/body
